## Daredevil Vol 3 6

> Knowledge is **power**, [Austin](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Austin_Cao_(Earth-616) "Austin Cao (Earth-616)"). Yeah, they'll stop at nothing to take it away from me. But until they do...that makes me the most **dangerous man alive**.

## Appearing in "Daredevil vs Bruiser"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Daredevil (Matt Murdock)](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Matthew_Murdock_(Earth-616) "Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)")

## Synopsis for "Daredevil vs Bruiser"

[Daredevil](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Matthew_Murdock_(Earth-616) "Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)") floats underwater after his beating at the hands of mercenary [Bruiser](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Bruiser_(Mercenary)_(Earth-616) "Bruiser (Mercenary) (Earth-616)"). He is jolted awake by the sound of a speedboat racing away carrying Bruiser and his unconscious hostage, [Mr. Randall](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Character_Index/R#Randall "Character Index/R"). Daredevil launches the grapple of his billy club, which catches onto the chassis of the boat. Daredevil is dragged behind the craft until it docks in a hangar at a mysterious building. Bruiser carries Randall into the compound and, after taking out the speedboat’s crew, Daredevil follows.

Daredevil is pinned to the floor with Bruiser’s hands around his throat, but he thinks he’s discovered the key to defeating the big man. He listens hard and hears Bruiser’s bones crack against the stress of Bruiser’s power. Daredevil uses his radar sense to find the exact weakest point in Bruiser’s knee, then unleashes a strike that completely shatters the bone. Bruiser screams in agony and falls.
